**Mumbai:** Disprz, a leading company for GenAI-powered learning and skilling solutions, has announced the appointment of Swati Sahai as its new Vice President and Head of Marketing. With over 15 years of experience in transformative marketing leadership, Sahai brings a wealth of expertise in driving success across the US, India, APAC and Europe SaaS markets.

Sahai has a proven track record of scaling marketing functions for multiple SaaS organizations and leading demand-generation initiatives that have delivered measurable revenue impact. Her core expertise includes executing go-to-market (GTM) strategies, managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets, driving brand transformations, and building high-performing marketing teams.

Before joining Disprz, Sahai held key leadership roles, including Vice President of Marketing at Netcore Cloud and Sefas Innovation. She also served as the Director of Marketing at Sefas North America, where she played a crucial role in expanding the company’s market presence.

Advertisement

Sahai holds a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing from the Symbiosis Institute of International Business and a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) in Commerce & Marketing from the University of Allahabad. She also completed a Digital Marketing certification from Harvard Extension School in 2013.

In her new role, Sahai will be responsible for strengthening Disprz’s global marketing strategy, enhancing brand visibility, and accelerating demand generation efforts. Her leadership is expected to contribute to the company’s growth as it continues to enable personalized learning for knowledge and frontline workers worldwide.
